summary: More grafana.grafana changes in Ansible 12: a user module to manage Grafana users, alloy_readiness_check_use_https, declared collection dependencies, alerting provisioning directory, grafana.ini YAML syntax, SLES init-script support, no_log on config deployment, APT key stored as .asc, and use of ansible_facts instead of ansible_* variables.
questions: Is there a module to manage Grafana users in grafana.grafana?
Does the grafana role support SLES?
